description:
A backup operator is testing file restore capability. In your home directory (/home/user), there is a file named "/home/user/documents/backup_list.txt" which contains a list of important files, one per line.

Simulate a file restoration by producing a report as follows:

1. For each filename in "/home/user/documents/backup_list.txt", append the current date and time (in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" format, 24-hour clock) to the filename, separated by a comma and a single space.
2. Save the results as "/home/user/reports/restore_report.txt".
3. Each line in "restore_report.txt" should correspond to each line from the original backup list, in the same order.

For example, an output line should look exactly like:
somefile.txt, 2024-04-14 09:17:32

Verify that the report contains one line per file in the same order as the input, with the correct date-time stamp format for each.
